description_excerpt: Job Description • Receive and review testing orders, SOP’s and instruction before conducting testing. • Perform tests in a professional and safe manner, ensure that tests are carried out in accordance with testing orders, SOP and clients' instruction and as per division quality procedures • Keep Manager/ Supervisor/ Team Leader informed on daily basis or as required about the progress of the testing and report any problems identified when performing tests. • Prepare accurate and detailed written test reports and pass to the Manager/ Supervisor/ Team Leader for review • All data related to…
